expected.notes: This case includes a decoy line explicitly mentioning "Computer equipment fixtures" so the nature classifier or account-name similarity is tempted to promote 1513 (Jonas-convention accum-depr, stored as ASSET/DEBIT). Structural CONTRA_ASSET rule DOES NOT fire on ASSET/DEBIT — Phase 2 catches it via the nature-conditioned ASSET-excluded-from-OPERATING rule instead. If this case regresses to recommending 1513/1514/1710/1720/1730, the eligibility layer has a hole.
